data.name: Description
data.value: Jarvis says aloud when a Claude Code session ends or waits for you. Choose when it stays silent and what it announces for each folder.

data.name: NowHint
data.value: A quiet period changes no setting and ends by itself. Jarvis offers one when you tell it you are going to sleep.

data.name: Now_Hours
data.value: Quiet hours: announcements are only written in the conversation.

data.name: Now_Period
data.value: Quiet period until {0}: announcements are only written in the conversation.

data.name: HoursHint
data.value: Every day, between these hours, nothing is said: the announcement stays written in the conversation. None by default.

data.name: FoldersHint
data.value: What Jarvis announces for the sessions of each folder. Everything by default.

data.name: NoFolder
data.value: No folder yet: allow a folder, or let a session be seen through its hooks.

data.name: Level_WaitsOnly
data.value: Only when it waits for me

data.name: Limit_Rest
data.value: An announcement never interrupts you nor an answer: it waits until Jarvis is at rest. After ten minutes of waiting it is no longer said.

data.name: Limit_Written
data.value: Every announcement is written in the conversation, said or not. It is never sent to a model.

data.name: Limit_Hooks
data.value: A session you start yourself is announced only once its hooks are installed (page "Claude Code hooks").

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: The setting could not be saved.
